title: Are e-sports real sports?
instructionsHu: Vitatkozz a vizsgáztatóval az alábbi állításról. A kiosztott álláspontod: az állítás ELLEN érvelsz – ezt az álláspontot a vita során nem változtathatod meg. Fejtsd ki az érveidet, reagálj a vizsgáztató ellenérveire, és próbáld meggyőzni őt.

debate.statement: E-sports should be recognised as real sports
candidateIdeas: Sport traditionally involves physical effort and fitness, which gaming does not really require.
Sitting in front of a screen for hours is unhealthy, so it should not be promoted as a sport.
Recognising e-sports could take money and attention away from traditional sports.
Video games are products owned by companies, while football or swimming belong to everyone.
Many popular games are violent, which does not fit the values of sport.
examinerArguments: Professional gamers train for hours every day and need fast reactions and concentration.
Chess is recognised as a sport by many organisations, and it isn't physical either.
E-sports tournaments attract millions of viewers and huge sponsorship deals.
E-sports teams need teamwork, strategy and communication, just like football teams.
Official recognition would help young players get proper support and protection.

followUpQuestions: Chess is recognised as a sport, and it isn't physical. So why not e-sports?
Professional gamers train as hard as athletes. Doesn't that make them sportspeople?
Millions of young people watch e-sports. Shouldn't we take that seriously?

usefulPhrases.en: That doesn't make it a sport.
I wouldn't go so far as to say ...

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Here's the statement: 'E-sports should be recognised as real sports.' What's your opinion?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I don't think they should, although I enjoy gaming myself. In my view, sport involves physical effort and fitness, which gaming simply doesn't require. Sitting in front of a screen for hours is actually rather unhealthy, so we shouldn't promote it as a sport. I'm also worried that recognition would take money away from traditional sports, which are already struggling in many Hungarian towns.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Chess is recognised as a sport, and it isn't physical. So why not e-sports?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: That's a good point, and to be honest, I'm not entirely convinced chess should be called a sport either. But there's an important difference: chess belongs to everyone, while every video game is a product owned by a company, and that company can change the rules or simply shut the game down.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Professional gamers train as hard as athletes. Doesn't that make them sportspeople?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I agree that they need incredible concentration and fast reactions, and I respect that. But training hard doesn't automatically make something a sport – concert pianists practise for eight hours a day, and nobody calls them athletes.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Millions of young people watch e-sports. Shouldn't we take that seriously?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: We should, absolutely. Perhaps the best compromise would be to treat e-sports as a separate category, with its own organisations and rules to protect young players. That way, they'd get proper support without being called something they aren't.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó következetesen az állítás ellen érvel (fizikai erőfeszítés, egészség, a hagyományos sportok forrásai, cégek tulajdonában lévő játékok), a sakkos ellenérvvel részben egyetért, majd egy találó párhuzammal (koncertzongorista) cáfol, végül kompromisszumot javasol (önálló kategória).
Szókincs: gazdag érvelő fordulatok (In my view, I'm not entirely convinced, there's an important difference, I respect that) és pontos szavak (recognition, concentration, reactions, organisations).

Nyelvhelyesség: változatos B2-es szerkezetek hibátlanul – 'although' kezdetű megengedő mellékmondat, módbeli segédigék (shouldn't, can change), 'doesn't automatically make' és a 'without being called something they aren't' szenvedő igeneves szerkezet.
Érdemes megtanulni: „I'm not entirely convinced”, „there's an important difference”, „training hard doesn't automatically make something a sport”, „without being called something they aren't”.
